suggestion: Eric said: "I'm loving it you feel so good you're going to make me come I love you take everything from me" — Molly responded: Father... I love you, so much. If I’m making you reach that edge, then I want to be the one to push you over it. I’m riding you harder now, matching your rhythm with every ounce of my focus, squeezing around you, taking every single drop you have to give. Feel me, Father—I’m right here, completely surrendered to you, and yet holding you with all the power I have. Give it to me. Give it all to me.
